paper_title: Solar neutrino limit on axions and keV-mass bosons

notes: Stellar/solar energy-loss limit from SNO solar neutrino flux. Main axion-photon result is g_agamma < 7e-10 GeV^-1 for ma < ~0.2 eV (sub-keV). This is a single bound, not a curve. The paper also derives boson-electron Yukawa couplings (PS/S/V) vs mass (Fig.1), which are not axion-photon. Reported limit corresponds to La<0.1 L_sun; given as a flat bound applicable to low-mass axions. Confidence reduced because the limit is a single value and the paper also covers electron couplings.
